lab.title: Observe dependency injection lifetimes in ScratchPad
lab.objective: Build an IServiceCollection and ServiceProvider explicitly.
lab.task: Register three marker classes, resolve them in two scopes, and print which instances are reused.
lab.startingCondition: Session 29 tested the real synchronous payroll behavior. Session 30 now introduces the DI container itself in an isolated ScratchPad experiment; no earlier registration is assumed.

steps.text: Step 2/12: In the ScratchPad project, create folder Session30 and file Session30/LifetimeExperiments.cs.

Step 3/12: In LifetimeExperiments.cs, add using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection, then declare public sealed class LifetimeExperiments. sealed says this focused experiment is not designed for inheritance.
Step 4/12: Inside LifetimeExperiments, add public void Run and create a ServiceCollection inside that method. This method is the experiment composition root.
Step 5/12: Inside Run, call AddTransient<TransientMarker>, AddScoped<ScopedMarker>, and AddSingleton<SingletonMarker>. Read each signature as: register this service type with this reuse rule.
Step 6/12: Build the ScratchPad project in Release before adding resolution code.
Step 7/12: Inside Run, build the ServiceProvider and create two IServiceScope objects with using declarations.

Step 8/12: Inside the class but outside Run, add private static T Resolve<T>(IServiceScope scope) where T : notnull; return scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<T>(). The helper is private because only this experiment needs it.
Step 9/12: Inside Run, resolve each marker twice and use ReferenceEquals to print whether transient, scoped, and singleton objects are reused within and across scopes.
Step 10/12: Inside LifetimeExperiments but outside its methods, add three private sealed marker classes named TransientMarker, ScopedMarker, and SingletonMarker.
Step 11/12: At the end of ScratchPad/Program.cs, construct LifetimeExperiments and call Run without removing earlier session calls.
Step 12/12: Run ScratchPad, then build the full Release solution and run all tests with --no-build.

reveals.title: Solution
reveals.text: The complete experiment registers all three lifetimes, resolves within two scopes, and compares reference identity.
